📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: September 16, 2026)

On Wednesday, September 16, I attended the launch ceremony for the "Autumn National Traffic Safety Campaign."

From September 21 to September 30, we are conducting awareness activities focused on preventing traffic accidents during the autumn season.

I ask all residents to take extra care in driving safely.
